Tvs Motor Company Limited has informed the Exchange that at the meeting of the board of directors held on May 30, 2005, the directors have 1) Declared a second interim dividend of Re.0.60 per equity share of Re.1/- each for the year ended March 31, 2005 (60%). Together with the first interim dividend declared by the board at Re.0.70 per share (70%) which was paid to the shareholders on November 08, 2004, the aggregate of interim dividends declared for the current financial year ended March 31, 2005 is 130%. The board do not recommend any final dividend for the year and the interim dividends paid will be considered as the final dividend for the year ended March 31, 2005. The second interim dividend declared will be paid to the shareholders on or after June 13, 2005. 2) The AGM of the company will be held on August 17, 2005.  The Company has further informed regarding a press release dated May 30, 2005 titled "TVS MOTOR REPORTS RECORD SALES AND TURNOVER - Turnover Rs. 2,955.21 Crores, PBT Rs. 200.45 Crores and PAT Rs. 137.57 Crores - Announces An Additional Dividend of 60%. Tvs Motor Company Limited has informed the Exchange that the share transfer books and register of members of the Company will remain closed from June 7, 2005 to June 10, 2005 (both days inclusive) for the purpose of ascertaining the members who are eligible for such dividend. The Company has further informed that the dividend declared at the meeting to be held on May 30, 2005, will be paid to the shareholders on or after June 13, 2005. The rate and quantum of dividend proposed to be declared will be advised immediately after the board meeting.

Tvs Motor Company Limited has informed the Exchange that at the meeting of the BOD's held on February 23, 2005, the Board approved the following proposals: 1) A project for manufacture of two wheelers in Indonesia, initially with an annual capacity of 1.20 lakhs two wheelers with an investment upto USD 50 Million; 2) A project for setting up manufacturing facility for three wheelers in the existing Mysore plant with an initial annual capacity of 1.00 lakh vehicles. The estimated cost of project (Phase I) will be Rs.100 crores; 3) A project for setting up a two wheeler unit in Himachal Pradesh with an initial annual capacity of 3.00 lakhs vehicles at an estimated cost of Rs.90 crores.  The Company also proposes to invest Rs.40 crores by subscribing to the proposed issue of 6% redeemable preference shares by its associate company, TVS Finance and Services Limited, on preferential basis.

Clarification of News : The press had reports that TVS Motor Company Limited is likely to pick up a stake in LML Limited. The Exchange, in order to verify the accuracy or otherwise of the information reported in the press and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the officials of the company. TVS Motor Company Limited has vide its letter inter-alia stated, "We strongly deny that the company has any move to acquire any stake in LML. The news item appearing has no authority from the management of the company".
